label: Pelvic venous disorders and orthostatic intolerance: A systematic review of diagnostic associations and treatment outcomes.
summary: Pelvic venous disorders (PeVD) are recognised causes of chronic pelvic pain; emerging evidence suggests that venous outflow obstruction or reflux can also provoke orthostatic intolerance (OI) by infra-diaphragmatic pooling and reduced preload. Diagnostic and therapeutic frameworks for this overlap remain poorly defined. We systematically searched PubMed, Ovid MEDLINE, Scopus, and Cochrane to 20 May 2025.
